# Recap Media

> Recap Media is an event photography and video company for business events, founded by Maks Strzepka. Photo and video come under one booking, with one point of contact from the first call to the final delivery. Maks plans every booking and usually leads the coverage on site. Service area: Oslo, Fornebu, Sandvika, Lillestrøm, Drammen, Jessheim, Holmestrand, Moss and beyond. The full photo gallery arrives in up to 7 business days. Video arrives on the timeline agreed before the event, usually within 14 business days, with two revision rounds.

## Services

- [Event photography in Oslo](https://recapmedia.no/services/event-photography-oslo): Conferences and corporate events, with same-day selects and 24-hour press sets on request and the full gallery in up to 7 business days.
- [Event video in Oslo](https://recapmedia.no/services/event-video-oslo): Highlight films and social clips, plus session recordings when they are in the scope, on the timeline agreed before the event, usually within 14 business days.
- [Conference photography and video in Oslo](https://recapmedia.no/services/conference-photography-video-oslo): Photo and video across parallel rooms and several days, with the crew sized to what is agreed in the brief.
- [Corporate headshots in Oslo](https://recapmedia.no/services/headshots-oslo): Consistent portraits for new hires and whole teams, shot at your office, with full commercial usage rights.
- [All services](https://recapmedia.no/services): Every Recap Media service in one place.
- [Example coverage options](https://recapmedia.no/packages): What a typical photo and video booking includes, from half-day photography to multi-day conferences. The final quote is tailored after the brief.

## Case studies

- [Flutter Vikings 2022](https://recapmedia.no/work/flutter-vikings-2022-media-coverage-oslo): Conference photo and video in Oslo: three parallel rooms over two days, 46 speakers, and the talks became 43 videos.
- [Scotland-Norway Decarbonisation Trade Mission](https://recapmedia.no/work/scotland-norway-decarbonisation-trade-mission-event-photography-oslo): Corporate event photography for the 2023 trade mission in Oslo, with press-ready photos within 24 hours.
- [Patch Norway buyer tour](https://recapmedia.no/work/patch-norway-buyer-tour-event-video-oslo-bergen): Event video and photography for a two-day buyer tour by train from Oslo to Bergen to see CO₂ captured and stored.
- [Ocean Rise](https://recapmedia.no/work/ocean-rise-public-art-documentation-oslo): Video and photography documentation for Aphra Shemza's climate-focused public artwork in Tøyenparken, Oslo.
- [All case studies](https://recapmedia.no/work): Client events in Oslo and beyond.
